name: Crisp
description: Crisp is an all-in-one customer support platform combining AI-powered agents with live chat, shared inbox, and CRM tools to help businesses automate and streamline customer interactions.
best_for: Positioned for "every company" from startups to enterprises, aimed at customer support, sales, and marketing teams handling inquiries across multiple channels.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 2 seats, 100 customer profiles, website chat widget, shared inbox.

tiers.name: Mini
tiers.notes: 4 seats included, hard cap -- extra seats not sold individually, must upgrade tier. About $5 of AI credit (roughly 90 automated conversations). 5,000 profile cap.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.notes: 10 seats, hard cap. About $25 AI credit (roughly 450 conversations). Omnichannel (WhatsApp/Instagram/SMS), workflow automation, AI chatbot, knowledge base.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: 20 seats included -- the only tier where extra seats can be bought individually, at $10/seat/month. About $75 AI credit (roughly 1,350 conversations).

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales; custom SLA and onboarding.

cons: Billing is per-workspace with hard seat caps on Free/Mini/Essentials (2/4/10 seats) -- exceeding the cap by even one agent forces an upgrade to the next full tier; only the top Plus plan lets you buy extra seats individually.

AI automation is metered via a separate bundled credit allowance ($5 on Mini up to $75 on Plus, roughly 90-1,350 conversations) -- heavier chatbot usage than the bundle requires additional spend beyond the base plan price.
The free plan is capped at just 2 seats and 100 customer profiles, and excludes the omnichannel inbox, workflow automation, AI chatbot, and knowledge base -- all gated behind the $95+/month tiers.
features: Live chat widget for websites and mobile apps, with Chat SDK for developers
Shared inbox centralizing messages from multiple channels
Support CRM for organizing customer data
Ticketing, campaign management, and status page tools

alternatives.name: Help Scout
alternatives.description: A customer service platform centralizing email and other channels into a shared inbox with AI drafting.
alternatives.best_for: SaaS, ecommerce, and service teams wanting a shared-inbox-centric helpdesk.

alternatives.name: Gorgias
alternatives.description: A conversational AI helpdesk purpose-built for ecommerce and Shopify merchants.
alternatives.best_for: Ecommerce brands wanting support tied directly to order/revenue data.

alternatives.name: Zoho Desk
alternatives.description: An AI-powered customer service platform that unifies support conversations across channels into one inbox, with a Zia AI assistant that handles routine tickets autonomously.
alternatives.best_for: Customer-first businesses wanting unified multichannel ticketing with AI automation
